history.note: The original three. DeepSeek was called through the `deepseek-chat` alias until 2026-09-29; the alias had already been re-pointed to deepseek-flash, so the series did not change. Re-baselined on the fixed sample 2026-09-28 (docs/bakeoffs/2026-09-28-incumbents.md).

Claude Opus 5.5 replaces Claude Sonnet 4.6 ahead of its 2027-02-17 retirement; GPT-6.1 Sol is added after passing every gate of the first candidate round. Gemini 2.5 Flash and DeepSeek Flash stay; DeepSeek was re-scored under its current build. Same prompt (v1), same scale.

candidates.label: Sonnet 4.6
candidates.outcome_why: Stable and consistent; retires at Anthropic in February 2027, so a successor was sought.

candidates.label: Gemini 2.5 Flash
candidates.outcome_why: Healthy on every check; stored scores already match today's build.

candidates.label: DeepSeek Flash
candidates.outcome_why: Healthy on every check; re-scored under its current build at the v2 cut.

candidates.label: Claude Opus 5.5
candidates.decision: adopted as Sonnet 4.6's successor: the misses are explicit zeros, not scored boilerplate; every other gate and bar passed
candidates.outcome_why: The most stable reader measured and the closest to the set; it missed one gate by a single sentence of the 30-sentence null probe, on inspection a calibration difference (explicit zeros, not boilerplate read as signal), which the rule now allows.

candidates.label: Gemini 4 Argon
candidates.outcome_why: Strong agreement, but only 62% of its sentence scores repeat at temperature 0 (bar 75%). Re-screened when Google ships a new build.

candidates.label: DeepSeek V4 Pro
candidates.outcome_why: Reads the statements a full point more hawkish than everyone else and disagrees with itself between runs; not a comparable reader of this prompt.

candidates.label: GPT-6 Astra
candidates.decision: not added: identical to Sol (r 0.995) at five times the price
candidates.outcome_why: Passed everything, but it reads identically to GPT-6.1 Sol (r 0.995) at five times the price.

candidates.label: GPT-6.1 Sol
candidates.outcome_why: Passed every gate and bar; the same reading as the rest of the set with the least noise, at 2.5 cents a statement.

comparison.note: Measured on the fixed 200-statement sample, two replicates, replicate 0 for agreement. Source: docs/bakeoffs/2026-09-28-incumbents.md, 2026-10-21-candidates.md, 2026-10-23-gpt6.md.

ensembles.members: Opus 5.5 · Gemini 2.5 Flash · DeepSeek Flash · GPT-6.1 Sol

series_shift.note: Measured on the corpus after the cut (sentence-level ensembles). The sample-only figure (membership change alone, current builds throughout) was mean −0.02, MAD 0.16, r 0.995.

attribution.step: DeepSeek Flash: stored old-build scores → current build
Opus 5.5 in for the stored Sonnet 4.6
